_comment: Capability-root manifest for storage/ (ADR-0562). Every crate, capability file path, fixture path and accounting count below was read off the tree at authoring time, not transcribed from legacy microservices/ or libs/oya-storage-* dump paths.

substrate_dag_position._note: specs/capability-registry.json name=storage dag_node=storage stratum=S2 (floor from storage/core/domain -> cell and storage/facade/recordings -> comms; no ranked consumer ceiling)

_tier_subtype_note: Absorbed product-face manifests (drive/imaging/recordings) historically declare tier_subtype substrate-data; capability-registry does not declare a capability-root tier_subtype. Deliberately ABSENT on this root rather than inventing; subtype lands when the registry grounds one.
purpose: Object/blob storage + content-addressed store substrate (ADR-0536 D-11 / ADR-0520): provider-neutral object/block metadata invariants, tenant/cell object-key namespace guardrail, owned object-store/CAS kernel, deterministic S3/OCI command-shaping adapters, and storage product faces under storage/facade/{drive,recordings}. No live S3/OCI Object Storage/Block Volume/File Storage service, REST server, SDK, worker, object body persistence, volume attach, filesystem mount, measured foundation SLO, active-active DR, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, or audit-chain persistence is claimed by this capability-root slice.

bounded_contexts.name: storage-adapters
bounded_contexts.description: Transient-infra driven adapters under storage/adapters/ (deterministic S3/OCI command shaping; nativelink CAS k8s scaffold is not a Cargo crate).

bounded_contexts.name: storage-core
bounded_contexts.description: Pure kernel/domain surfaces under storage/core/ (resource residency/encryption/data-class invariants + owned object-store/CAS kernel).

bounded_contexts.name: storage-facade
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level product-face domain crates under storage/facade/ (Drive + Recordings kernels; not app/ multi-capability compositions).

bounded_contexts.name: storage-ports
bounded_contexts.description: Object/block API boundary crates under storage/ports/.

capability_root_accounting._overlap_note: All eight Cargo workspace members under storage/ live in capability-layer directories and are owned exclusively by this capability root. Absorbed product-face manifests under storage/{drive,imaging,recordings}/ declare empty crate lists today; facade kernels (storage-drive-domain, storage-recordings-domain) remain root-owned until a grounded placement ruling moves them.

contracts.contract_status: storage/ OpenAPI object+block contracts exist and are exercised by ports tests; AsyncAPI/proto under storage/contracts/ are metadata-only design evidence and do not prove runtime broker/gRPC service readiness. Parallel root contracts/openapi/cloud/cloud-storage-*-v1.yaml copies also exist outside this capability tree and are not re-cited here.

slo_exemption.rationale: storage/observability/slos/ contains 36 OpenSLO YAML scaffolds (mostly drive/imaging/recordings product-face intents). No measured foundation SLI or burn-rate rule is implemented for the capability-root local-foundation slice, so this root keeps slos=[] rather than claiming those scaffolds as live coverage.
slo_exemption.evidence: verified: storage/observability/slos/*.openslo.yaml exists (36 files) but CS-CLOUD-STORAGE-001 / this root slice implements no runtime SLI emitter; see storage/REORG-DRAIN.md

ips.title: Tenant/cell object namespace, object retention/versioning, block snapshot evidence, file mount-policy metadata guardrail, and Cloud Storage manifest truth-down

foundation_non_claims: no live S3/OCI Object Storage/Block Volume/CSI/NFS, SeaweedFS, MinIO, bucket creation, provider retention/versioning enablement, object body I/O, volume attach, filesystem mount, REST server, SDK, worker, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke, measured foundation SLO, capacity telemetry, DR, or audit-chain runtime persistence is implemented by this capability-root slice

legacy microservices/{drive,imaging,recordings} and libs/oya-storage-* dump paths are retired cites; all eight crates are homed under storage/ per ADR-0562 and must not be re-cited from dump paths in this manifest
explicit_non_claims: OpenSLO YAML under storage/observability/slos/ are product-face scaffolds and are not claimed as measured foundation coverage; slo_exemption above is the measured statement
storage/contracts/asyncapi and proto files are metadata-only design evidence and not runtime readiness proof
storage/adapters/nativelink/ is a k8s CAS scaffold (OWNERS + nativelink-cas.k8s.yaml) with no Cargo.toml and is not counted as a crate
Absorbed storage/{drive,imaging,recordings}/manifest.json still carry microservices/* path cites — tracked in storage/REORG-DRAIN.md, not silently rewritten by this root enrichment
